description: Synthesize functional architecture from extracted functions, types, and interfaces

actions.description: Identify natural groupings of related functions
actions.llm_guidance:
Group functions by:
- Shared dependencies
- Common data access patterns
- Naming conventions (UserX, OrderX)
- File/module organization
- Functional cohesion

Create functional_clusters array

actions.description: Identify major workflows through the system
actions.llm_guidance:
For workflow-based systems, identify:
- User-initiated flows (e.g., checkout flow)
- Batch processing flows
- Event-driven flows

For frame-based/real-time systems (games, emulators):
- Document the main loop structure
- Note that traditional workflows may not apply
- Set functional_flows to empty array if not applicable

actions.description: Connect entry points to functional clusters
actions.llm_guidance:
For each entry point from codebase_inventory:
- Identify the initial function chain
- Map to functional clusters
- Create entry_points array

Create specs/functional/functional_architecture.json using the template:
- metadata section (system name, source info)
- functions array (from extracted_functions)
- data_types array
- functional_clusters array
- entry_points array
- functional_flows array (may be empty for real-time systems)
- summary section

actions.description: Check that all functions are accounted for
actions.llm_guidance:
Verify:
- All extracted functions appear in the architecture
- No orphan functions (not in any cluster)
- All entry points are mapped
- Dependencies are consistent
